_comment: Rupture keyword fires from the card DB keywords field, no authoring needed. The pump is TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK + MODIFY_ATTACK gated by CHAIN_HIT_COUNT_GTE 4 (chain link 4 or higher = 3 prior links). CHAIN_HIT_COUNT_GTE reads len(chain_links) >= amount-1, matching the release note: 'there must already be 3 chain links on the combat chain before you play this'. ON_ATTACK fires when the attack enters the combat chain, so the +3{p} applies for the attack's power calculation.
